canonicalFindings.label: PRICE-SCALE-MAGNITUDE-FOOTGUN
canonicalFindings.rootCause: Immutable priceScale magnitude is unchecked at deploy time and silently mis-sizes the emission runway; too-high collapses runway (premature depletion), too-low re-introduces the floor-to-zero bug, absurd values revert as obvious misconfig. Includes the dispatcher-repoint corollary (immutable priceScale pins the contract to a single price-token-decimal regime).

instances.note: priceScale immutable, applied in schedule recompute

canonicalFindings.rationale: Solvency is structurally insensitive and owner self-corrects via setTargetAPY; not High/Medium. Non-obvious owner footgun (unknowing runway mis-sizing) keeps it in scope per Law 3. Single canonical finding consolidating the three magnitude/scaling duplicates.
canonicalFindings.preservedDetails: ECON-001 carries the most complete analysis (too-high/too-low/absurd trichotomy + dispatcher-repoint corollary + self-correction path).

canonicalFindings.label: MAINTENANCE-COUPLING-DRIFT
canonicalFindings.rootCause: NFTStakerPriceScaled.sol is a hand-maintained copy/fork of NFTStaker.sol; future NFTStaker fixes do not auto-inherit, creating a drift hazard. Disclosed in-source via NatSpec.
canonicalFindings.rationale: Already disclosed in-source NatSpec; no code defect. Process/maintenance note, not a security finding. Carry as context for future regression runs (couple NFTStaker fixes forward to this copy).

canonicalFindings.label: FLOOR-BEFORE-AMPLIFY-PRECISION-NEGLIGIBLE
canonicalFindings.rootCause: Floor-before-scale division precision in the priceScale arithmetic path. Relative error provably bounded <1/latestPrice_unscaled (~2.5 ppb) and conservative-for-protocol (rounds against the user, never toward over-mint).
canonicalFindings.rationale: Code-scanner proved the precision loss negligible and protocol-conservative. Recorded as a refuted/non-issue so the pattern is not re-surfaced next run.

canonicalFindings.label: BASELINE-INHERITED-STATIC
canonicalFindings.rootCause: Group of low-confidence static-analyzer hits that are byte-identical to, or deliberate copies of, behavior in the already-audited NFTStaker.sol baseline.

instances.note: reentrancy; mitigated by OZ nonReentrant, in-system callee; identical to audited baseline
unused-return on nftMinter.configs(...) tuple; deliberate, price field feeds priceScale multiply
block.timestamp use; deliberate, byte-identical to baseline
missing zero-check on owner-only setters; Law-3 owner-trust

canonicalFindings.disposition: PROCEED to sanitizer (suppress against prior NFTStaker baseline)
canonicalFindings.rationale: All four are confidence:low, baseline-inherited, and either tool-noise or Law-3 owner-trust. Not new findings. Hand to sanitizer to suppress against the prior audited baseline rather than re-report. ADERYN-001 additionally falls under Law-3 trusted-owner (obvious, suppress).

canonicalFindings.label: INHERITED-M02-EMERGENCYWITHDRAW-OVEREMISSION
canonicalFindings.rootCause: Inherited M-02 emergencyWithdraw over-emission from NFTStaker.sol (survivor over-emission via skipped schedule recompute). Byte-identical to baseline; already triaged WONT-FIX (owner-ack 2026-06-09).
canonicalFindings.rationale: Inherited copy of an already-triaged WONT-FIX Medium (NFTStaker M-02). Carried as ledger context so the inheritance is visible; not a new finding and must not re-open the closed baseline entry.
